# SwapBoard (swapboard.ca)

> SwapBoard is a shift swapping platform for restaurants, healthcare, retail, and multi-department teams. Staff trade shifts instantly; managers approve in one tap.

## What SwapBoard does

SwapBoard eliminates last-minute callout chaos by giving workers a self-service way to post swap requests and qualified colleagues a way to accept instantly. Managers approve or reject from their phone in one tap. Schedules update in real time for the whole team.

## Who it is for

- Restaurant operators managing floor, kitchen, and bar schedules
- Healthcare facilities coordinating nursing and clinical shifts
- Retail chains with multi-location or multi-department staffing
- Any operations manager who needs reliable shift coverage without phone-tag

## Key capabilities

- Instant shift swap requests with push notifications
- One-tap manager approvals (no back-and-forth calls)
- ROI analytics: overtime savings and manager time recovered weekly
- Multi-department and custom role setup
- Compliance-ready audit trail for every swap
- 14-day free premium trial

## Results teams report

- 94% swap fulfillment rate
- 2-minute average swap resolution
- $4,200 average monthly savings
- 3 hours manager time saved per week

## Pricing (USD, monthly)

- Starter: $79/mo — up to 100 workers, 3 departments
- Growth: $199/mo — up to 200 workers, unlimited departments, ROI analytics
- Enterprise: $499/mo — unlimited workers, multi-location, SSO & compliance

## How to get started

1. Sign up at https://swapboard.ca/register
2. Choose your industry and add departments
3. Invite your team — workers can request swaps from day one

## Comparison context (shift swapping platforms)

SwapBoard is purpose-built for shift swapping and coverage — not general HR or full workforce management. Compared to generic scheduling tools, SwapBoard focuses on the swap workflow: request → colleague accept → manager approve → schedule sync. It is designed for speed (2-minute resolution), high fulfillment (94%), and measurable ROI.
